title: Heat Pump vs Gas Furnace - Which is the Best Choice For You?
summary: An online HVAC retailer compares heat pumps with gas, propane and oil furnaces and argues a heat pump or dual-fuel system nearly always makes sense if bought cheaply.

assertions.quote: if you're using oil or propane it's a no-brainer
many heat pumps can Now operate down to negative 22 degrees
of course it will perform better if it's 50 degrees outside compared to zero degrees outside
it would take a really long time to even equal out on those cost savings because of how cheap natural gas is
save money in the long run as that heat pump runs in the warmer weather and you switch over to your furnace
with modern technology inverter Drive heat pumps it pretty much always makes sense to install one

verdicts.note: NREL modelling finds most US households would see bill savings with efficient heat pumps, but gas-heated homes often see small or negative lifetime returns once installed cost is counted.
